title: Flag
description: A flag raised on content or a run. R4 B7. ⚠️ SEPARATE FROM RESULTS, deliberately: a flag folded into a result payload becomes a mark against whoever the result is about, and the flag layer exists to surface a PROBLEM WITH THE CONTENT, not a judgement about a person.

raisedAgainst.description: A content or run reference. NEVER a participant.

kind.description: Every member is about the CONTENT. There is no member for 'this person did badly'.

$comment: `raisedAgainst` cannot name a participant and `kind` has no member about one — so a flag against a person is UNREPRESENTABLE. Gamify the learning behaviour, never the safety state, and never the person.
